You create a web app named app1 that runs on an Azure virtual machine named vm1. Vm1 is on an Azure virtual network named vnet1.
You plan to create a new Azure Cognitive Search service named service1.
You need to ensure that app1 can connect directly to service1 without routing traffic over the public internet.
Solution: You deploy service1 and a private endpoint to vnet1.
Does this meet the goal?
discussion:
Yes is CORRECT because deploying the Azure Cognitive Search service (service1) with a private endpoint to the same virtual network (vnet1) as the virtual machine (vm1) ensures that app1 can connect directly to service1 without routing traffic over the public internet. A private endpoint provides a private IP address for the service within the virtual network, enabling secure and private connectivity.

"deploy service1 and a private endpoint to vnet1." is correct.

A is the correct answer.

The best answer is:
• A. Yes
Reason for choosing this option:
The solution meets the goal because deploying the Azure Cognitive Search service (service1) and a private endpoint to the Azure virtual network (vnet1) allows the web app (app1) on the virtual machine (vm1) to connect directly to service1. This setup ensures that the traffic between app1 and service1 does not route over the public internet, enhancing security and performance.

this is the right solution to the scenario

A is the answer.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/service-create-private-endpoint#why-use-a-private-endpoint-for-secure-access
Private Endpoints for Azure Cognitive Search allow a client on a virtual network to securely access data in a search index over a Private Link. The private endpoint uses an IP address from the virtual network address space for your search service. Network traffic between the client and the search service traverses over the virtual network and a private link on the Microsoft backbone network, eliminating exposure from the public internet.

By deploying a private endpoint to vnet1, the traffic between app1 and service1 can be routed through the Azure backbone network instead of over the public internet, providing a more secure and reliable connection.

Private Endpoint is the right solution to avoid public internet access
